text: Ning Caichen, a timid debt collector, takes shelter in [a deserted temple in the forest|who_suffers|newcomers and travellers] and falls in love with Nie Xiaoqian, who visits him there at night. The Taoist priest Yan Chixia warns him that the temple holds ghosts, and Ning learns that Nie is one, [enslaved by a Tree Demoness|threat|the devil and dark gods] because [her remains lie buried at the foot of its tree|rules|tied to place or thing]. Determined to free her soul, Ning follows her even into the Underworld.
